roofline_notes: Direct kernel uses FP32 FMA for residual, integer bit extraction, FP16 loads/conversion, PyTorch FP32 core contractions and activation/output block-16 FWHT. It cannot use the tensor-core peak as its compute ceiling. Intermediate vectors and contractions, repeated launches, and cache-resident reuse are included in complete-operator timing. Copy bandwidth is diagnostic, not proof of decompression being free. Bank timings include gating/routing; no complete model generation or streaming-working-set speed claim is established.
